_note: Pre-registered BEFORE the first scored run. Weights, thresholds, and breakpoints are frozen with the fixture lock; changing any of them opens a NEW scoring epoch, never a revision of an existing score. See README.md § Pre-registration.

thresholds._note: A component score at or above its threshold is reported as met. Thresholds are reporting bands, not pass/fail gates — the bench measures a distance, it does not adjudicate.
thresholds._separation: A faithful port must out-score a regenerated one by at least this much on the weighted total; the bench asserts its own discriminating power rather than assuming it.

ssim._note: 8x8 windowed SSIM on the luma channel. Raw pixel equality would measure font antialiasing rather than fidelity, which is why no equality check exists here.
